class.name: ProposedMove
class.brief_description: What a movement mode asks for, before anything has been swept or resolved.
class.description: The split between proposing a move and executing it is the reason this type exists. A proposal is side effect free, so proposals can be blended - which is what makes a dash on top of a walk possible without the walking code knowing about dashes. Fusing the two, which is what a single do-the-movement method would be, forecloses that permanently.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears every field back to its default.
